findings.title: Proceeds from Disposals has no plan data
findings.detail: Referenced by Cash Flow from Investing Activities but evaluates to 0 in every version.
findings.prompt: Proceeds from Disposals (cf-disposals) has no data. Should it stay in the Cash Flow from Investing Activities formula, and how should it be planned (driver, % of another line, or ML forecast)?

findings.title: Add Impairment of Credits (IFRS 9 ECL) % of Operating Income
findings.detail: Impairment of Credits (IFRS 9 ECL) has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Impairment of Credits (IFRS 9 ECL) % of Operating Income" = cogs / rev * 100.

findings.title: Add Operating Expenses (excl. depreciation) % of Operating Income
findings.detail: Operating Expenses (excl. depreciation) has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Operating Expenses (excl. depreciation) % of Operating Income" = opex-excl / rev * 100.

findings.title: Add Profit before Tax % of Operating Income
findings.detail: Profit before Tax has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Profit before Tax % of Operating Income" = ebt / rev * 100.

findings.title: Interest, Commission & Life Insurance Income moved EUR -381M vs Budget

findings.prompt: Explain the EUR -381M movement in Interest, Commission & Life Insurance Income between Budget and 9+3 Forecast and its impact through to EBITDA and Net Income.
